title: Mother with Baby Carriage, Palm Tree Park - Vintage 1940s Sepia Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
10/14/47

5 weeks old

You can't tell much -
but that's the
dress I made.

The pictures were
taken in the park
right near our
house.
description: A stylish young mother poses on a concrete walkway in a public park next to a large vintage baby pram, with a small palm tree visible directly behind her. She wears an open-front tailored overcoat over a belted patterned floral dress that she hand-made herself, as noted on the back of the photograph. The inscription dates the scene to October 14, 1947, noting her newborn was 5 weeks old at the time.
